y-m-71-04.title: Haddii aan labada dhinac ku qaybino a, b = c ma tahay?
y-m-71-04.goal: Ku muuji tusaale lid ku ah in wax-soo-saaro dot oo isle'eg aysan ka dhigin laba vector isle'eg, oo xisaabi imisa ayaa hadha marka shuruudda cabbirka lagu daro.
y-m-71-04.material: Vector-yada dhidibka waa a = (2, 1) iyo c = (1, 3). Jisu waxay tidhi, 'Maadaama a · b = a · c, ku qaybinta labada dhinac a waxay bixisaa b = c.' (Dhibicdu waxay ka dhigan tahay wax-soo-saarka dot.) b wuxuu leeyahay qaabka b = (b1, b2) qaybihiisuna waa tirooyin dhab ah.
y-m-71-04.thinking.0: Tijaabinta haddii xeerarka xisaabta ee tirooyinka si toos ah loogu wareejin karo wax-soo-saarka dot ee vector-yada
y-m-71-04.thinking.1: Samaynta dhowr vector oo buuxiya shuruud
y-m-71-04.thinking.2: Ka fikirka tirada xalalka marka shuruud la daro
y-m-71-04.prereq.0: Malo-awaal: hawshani waxay ku taal heer sare oo dugsiga sare ah, si loo xalliyo kadib barashada koorsada dooran 'Joomatari' (qaybaha kooxda, vector-yada dhidibka, shaxanka iyo isku-xigeenada bannaanka); 'H3' waa calaamad adag oo xirmadan soo saarista oo keliya macnaheeduna maaha in koorsada loo qoondeeyay fasal gaar ah. Qaabka qaybaha vector-yada dhidibka, xisaabinta wax-soo-saarka dot iyadoo la isticmaalayo qaybaha, cabbirka vector
y-m-71-04.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay habka ugu hubaalka ah ee lagu hubiyo haddii gabagabada Jisu 'b = c' ay had iyo jeer sii jirto?
y-m-71-04.s.s1.hint.0: Xalli a · b = a · c qaybo ahaan oo u qor sida isla'eg u dhexeysa b1 iyo b2.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.hint.1: Dooro hal b oo buuxiya isla'egtaas oo la barbar dhig c.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.a: Geli b badan oo arag haddii dhammaantood yihiin b = c
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.a: Ururinta tusaalayaal oo eegista kuwa ku habboon oo keliya ma muujin karto 'had iyo jeer'. Gaar ahaan, tusaalayaasha aad dooratid waxay u janjeedhi karaan hal dhinac.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.b: Hubi in maadaama a aanu ahayn vector eber, labada dhinac waan ku qaybin karnaa
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad xeerka tirtirista ee lagu isticmaalo dhufashada tirooyinka si toos ah ugu wareejisay wax-soo-saarka dot. Wax-soo-saarka dot waa hawlgal u beddela vector-yada tiro.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.c: Raadi b leh a · b = a · c iyo b ≠ c
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad isticmaashay xaqiiqda ah in si loo jebiyo 'had iyo jeer', hal tusaale oo buuxiya shuruudda laakiin leh gabagabo khaldan ayaa ku filan.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.d: Marka hore barbar dhig haddii b iyo c ay leeyihiin isla cabbir
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.d: Cabbir isku mid ahaanshaha waa shuruud lagama maarmaan ah b = c, laakiin marka hore waa inaad hubisaa haddii ay ka soo baxayso shuruudda la bixiyay.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.explain: Si loo jebiyo 'had iyo jeer way sii jirtaa', hal tusaale oo buuxiya shuruudda a · b = a · c halka b ≠ c ayaa ku filan.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.prompt: Gali 3 b = (b1, b2) oo kala duwan oo leh qaybo tirooyin dhan ah oo buuxiya a · b = a · c laakiin b ≠ c. (|b1| ≤ 5)
y-m-71-04.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore xisaabi qiimaha a · c adigoo geliya c, kadibna u qor a · b qaybo ahaan oo ka dhig isle'eg.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.hint.1: Dooro b1 oo hubi sida b2 loo go'aamiyo, kadibna hubi in b uu ka duwan yahay c.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a · b wuxuu le'eg yahay a · c.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a · b ma le'ka a · c (= 5).
y-m-71-04.s.s2.ok.c2: b wuu ka duwan yahay c.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.fail.c2: b waa isla c. Hel vector kale.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.explain: a · c = 2·1 + 1·3 = 5, sidaas darteed waxaa ku filan 2b1 + b2 = 5. Waxaa jira intii aad rabto, sida (0, 5), (2, 1), (3, −1). b kasta oo sidaas ah wuxuu leeyahay isla qaybta jihada a sida c wuxuuna ku kala duwan yahay qaybta u toosan a oo keliya.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.prompt: Haddii aad sidoo kale ku darto |b| = |c| (cabbirka b wuxuu le'eg yahay cabbirka c), imisa b guud ahaan ayaa leh a · b = a · c iyo b ≠ c? (Qaybuhu waa tirooyin dhab ah.)
y-m-71-04.s.s3.hint.0: Beddel b2 = 5 − 2b1 b1² + b2² = 10 si aad u samayso odhaah ku saabsan b1.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.hint.1: Hubi haddii c laftigiisu ku jiro xalalka la helay oo ka saar.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.a: Waxaad u malaysay b = c inuu yahay kan keliya. Wada xalli labada isla'eg oo xisaabi imisa qiimood oo b1 ayaa soo baxa.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad garatay in labada shuruudood ay ku dhawaad go'aamiyaan b. Haddii aad si toos ah u xalliso, mid kale ayaa hadha marka laga reebo b = c.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad ku waafajisay 2-da xal ee labada isla'eg. Ma hubisay haddii mid ka mid ah uu yahay c laftigiisa?
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.d: Waxaad keentay gabagabada marka ay jirto hal shuruud. Maadaama ay jirto isla'eg dheeraad ah, xisaabi sida xalalku isu beddelmaan.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.explain: Isku-darka 2b1 + b2 = 5 iyo b1² + b2² = 10 wuxuu bixiyaa (1, 3) iyo (3, −1). (1, 3) waa c laftigiisa, sidaas darteed b-ga keliya ee ka duwan c waa (3, −1). b-kani waa vector c oo laga muraayadeeyay xariiqda jihada a.

y-m-71-08.title: Iyadoo ku xidhan booska bar, imisa taabasho ayaa la sawiri karaa?
y-m-71-08.goal: Sii-sheeg oo dib u eeg tirada taabashooyinka la sawiri karo laga bilaabo bar ka baxsan, ku taal, iyo ku jirta parabola y² = 4x, oo sharax taabashada xalka u arka jiirka sida xarfo seegayo.
y-m-71-08.material: Tixgeli parabola y² = 4x (y labajibbaaran la simanyahay afar x). Geeska waa O(0, 0). Waxaan rabnaa inaan helno imisa xariijin oo taabasho ah ayaa parabolada lagu sawiri karaa laga bilaabo bar A sagxadda isku-xidhka. Haddii barta ay parabola ku taal, waxaan tirinaa xariijinta taabashada ee barta marta. Dhererku cutub ma laha.
y-m-71-08.thinking.1: Dib u eegista xukunkaaga marka bar cusub soo baxdo
y-m-71-08.prereq.0: Malo-awaal: hawshani waxay ku taal heer sare dugsiga sare, si loo xalliyo ka dib marka la baray koorsada doorashada 'Joomatari' (qaybaha conic, vector-yada sagxadda, jirrada iyo isku-xidhyada hawada); 'H3' waa calaamad adkaan oo kaliya oo dufcaddan wax-soo-saarka mana tusayso in koorsada loo meelaynayo fasal gaar ah. Qaabka caadiga ah ee parabola, isla'egta taabasho (taabashada leh jiir m waxay leedahay qaabka y = mx + 1/m), kala-soocaha isla'egta labajibbaarka ah
y-m-71-08.s.s1.prompt: Baraha waxaa la muujiyaa hal-hal. Mar kasta sii-sheeg tirada taabashooyinka la sawiri karo laga bilaabo barta.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.hint.0: Geli isku-xidhyada barta y² = 4x oo isbarbar dhig kee ka weyn y² iyo 4x.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.hint.1: Qor taabashada leh jiir m sida y = mx + 1/m, geli isku-xidhyada barta si aad u samayso isla'eg ku saabsan m, oo hubi calaamadda kala-soocaha.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Imisa taabasho ayaa laga sawiri karaa A ilaa parabola?
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Taabashada y = mx + 1/m ee marta A(1, 3) waxay buuxisaa 3 = m + 1/m, taasi waa, m² − 3m + 1 = 0, kala-soocahiisu waa 5, togan, sidaa darteed waxaa jira laba jiir. Barta waa dibadda, sidaa darteed waxaa jira 2 taabasho.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaad u malaysay inay jirto hal taabasho oo keliya. Tijaabi haddii aad heli karto laba jiir oo kala duwan oo taabasho ah oo maraya barta.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ma kala saartay haddii barta ay parabola ka baxsan tahay mise ku jirto. Ka fikir dhinaca taabashooyinka laga sawiri karo.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Xusuusta ah in laba taabasho ay jiraan bar dibadda ah iyo isbarbar dhigga booska barta way isku habboon yihiin.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Imisa taabasho ayaa laga sawiri karaa B?
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Taabashada marta B(1, 2) waxay buuxisaa 2 = m + 1/m, taasi waa, (m − 1)² = 0, sidaa darteed waxaa jira hal jiir oo keliya (m = 1). Bar parabola ku taal, waxaa jira 1 taabasho.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waxaad xukuntay in bar parabola ku taal ay jirto taabashada barta kaliya.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Waxaad sii qaadatay gabagabada barta dibadda. Barta kani waxay ku taal parabola, sidaas darteed booska wuu isbeddelay.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Bar parabola ku taal waxaa jira xariiq halkaas ku taabanaysa. Hubi haddii ay jirto taabane maraya barta.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Imisa taabane ayaa laga sawiri karaa C?
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Taabanaha maraya C(4, 1) wuxuu buuxiyaa 1 = 4m + 1/m, taasi waa, 4m² − m + 1 = 0, discriminant-kuna waa 1 − 16 < 0, sidaas darteed jaleeco ma jirto. Bar gudaha ah, taabane laguma sawiri karo.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad sii qaadatay gabagabada barta parabola ku taal. Barta kani kuma taal parabola.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waxaad ku xukuntay inay tahay bar parabola gudaheeda ah, sidaas darteed taabane gabi ahaanba ma jiro.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waxaad sii qaadatay gabagabada barta dibadda. Barbar dhig cabbirrada 4x iyo y² si aad u hubiso haddii ay gudaha tahay.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.reflect: Tirooyinka taabanayaasha saddexda bar waxay ahaayeen 2, 1 iyo 0. Sidee u sheegi kartaa booska bar adigoo barbar dhigaya cabbirrada y² iyo 4x? Sidoo kale ka fikir sida barbar dhiggani ugu xidhan yahay calaamadda discriminant-ka.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.prompt: Imisa xariiq oo taabanaya ayaa parabola laga sawiri karaa barta D(0, 3)? Hel oo qor dhammaan xariiqyada taabanaya, oo sidoo kale barbar dhig haddii tani waafaqsan tahay natiijada xalka dejinaya jaleecada m.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.hint.0: Qor sida isla'egta a·m² − b·m + 1 = 0 ee m u isbeddesho marka isku-duubka x ee D uu yahay 0.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.hint.1: Tiri imisa xariiq oo taabanaya ayaad ka heshay odhaahda m, oo sawir xariiqyo maraya barta D jihooyin kala duwan si aad u aragto haddii ay jiraan xariiqyo dheeraad ah oo parabola ku kulma hal bar oo keliya.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxay erayadayda sida isla'egtu u isbeddesho xalka dejinaya jaleecada sida m?
y-m-71-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma kala saaray taabane leh jaleeco iyo taabane jaleecadiisa aan la isticmaali karin?
y-m-71-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma hubiyey in taabanayaasha aan qoray runtii maraan D(0, 3)?
y-m-71-08.s.s2.model.0: 2. Geliinta (0, 3) y = mx + 1/m waxay siinaysaa 3 = 1/m, sidaas darteed hal taabane oo keliya y = x/3 + 3 oo leh jaleeco 1/3 ayaa soo baxda, laakiin dhidibka y (x = 0), oo aan lahayn jaleeco, sidoo kale waa taabane fiiqda, sidaas darteed wadar ahaan waa 2.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.model.1: Waxaa jira laba taabane. Tani waa suurtagal sababtoo ah barta D waxay ku taal dibadda parabola, hal waa x = 0 kan kale na waa y = (1/3)x + 3. x = 0 lagu qori karo ma aha qaabka y = mx + n, sidaas darteed xalka isticmaalaya jaleecada ayaa seegaya.

y-m-71-01.title: Ma jirtaa hal dhibic oo keliya oo 10 ka fog diiradda?
y-m-71-01.goal: Xal helaya dhibco adigoo isticmaalaya shuruudda masaafada laga bilaabo dhibic parabola ku taal ilaa diiradda, hel khadka ka seegay simitarinta, oo adigu xalli imisa dhibcood ayaa shuruudda buuxiya wadar ahaan.
y-m-71-01.material: Ka fiirso parabola y² = 8x (loo akhriyo: y labajibbaaran waa sideed x) oo ku taal diyaaradda isku-ordinaadka. Ha noqoto F diiradda parabolahan, oo dhibicda P(x, y) ha noqoto dhibic parabola ku taal. Arday ayaa u xalliyey dhibaatada helista dhammaan dhibcaha P ee masaafada PF le'eg 10 sida hoose. Cutubyada isku-ordinaadku dhammaantood waa isku mid, dhererradana waxaa loo qoray cutub la'aan.

y-m-71-01.thinking.2: Ka xukunka in xal jiro iyadoo laga eegayo xadka qiimayaasha suurtagalka ah

Qeexidda parabola (diirad iyo tilmaame-xariiq), diirad iyo tilmaame-xariiq ee qaabka y²=4px, qaaciidada masaafada u dhexeysa laba dhibcood

y-m-71-01.s.s1.hint.0: Si toos ah ugu geli tibaaxda khad kasta khadka xiga, oo isbarbar dhig in tirada kiisaska la yareeyey marka laga gudbo khad hore ilaa mid dambe.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qor dhammaan qiimayaasha y qaadan karto marka x = 8 lagu geliyo isleegga parabola.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.0: Qaabka y² = 4px, 4p = 8, sidaas darteed p = 2, diiradda F waa (2, 0), tilmaame-xariiqduna waa x = −2.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.1: Dhibic P(x, y) parabola ku taal, PF waxay le'eg tahay masaafada P ilaa tilmaame-xariiqda, sidaas darteed PF = x + 2.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.2: PF = 10, sidaas darteed x + 2 = 10, taasoo ah x = 8.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.3: y² = 8 · 8 = 64, sidaas darteed y = 8, dhibicda keliya ee shuruudda buuxisaa waa P(8, 8).
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.4: Sidaas darteed dhibicda P ee PF = 10 waa (8, 8).
y-m-71-01.s.s1.explain: Khadadka 1 ilaa 3 waa sax. Khadka 4, haddii y² = 64 markaas y = 8 ama y = −8. Parabola waa simitari dhidibka x, sidaas darteed labada dhibcood (8, 8) iyo (8, −8) labaduba shuruudda ayay buuxiyaan. Khadka 5 wuxuu si fudud u dhaxlay ka tagista khadka 4.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.prompt: Geli 2 dhibcood oo kala duwan P(x, y) oo parabola ku taal oo leh isku-ordinaad tirooyin dhan oo buuxiya PF = 10. (Diiradda F waa (2, 0).)
y-m-71-01.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor xiriirka u dhexeeya x iyo y sida isleeg adigoo isticmaalaya shuruudda ah dhibicdu parabola ku taal.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dooro hal x, hubi in y u soo baxo tiro dhan, oo si toos ah u xisaabi masaafada laga bilaabo dhibicdaas ilaa F.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Dhibicdu waxay ku taalaa parabola y² = 8x.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.explain: Baraha keliya ee buuxiya labada shuruudood waa (8, 8) iyo (8, −8). x waa hal qiime oo go'an calaamadda y oo keliya ayaa leh laba suurtagalnimo.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.prompt: Imisa bar P ee isla parabola ku taal ayaa leh PF = 1?

y-m-71-01.s.s3.hint.1: Si toos ah u xisaabi masaafada gacmaha O(0, 0) ilaa F.

y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.a: Haddii aad si toos ah u xisaabiso PF gacmaha, ma aha 1. Waxaad qiyaastay barta ugu dhow adigoo aan xisaabin.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.o.b: Laba. Laba bar oo is-simanaya dhidibka x
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad keentay gabagabada 'laba bar oo is-simanaya' ee tallaabadii hore sida ay ahayd. Marka hore waa inaad hubisaa haddii qiimaha x uu suurtagal yahay.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.o.c: Lama ogaan karo. Qaabka oo keliya lagama go'aamin karo
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.c: Odhaahda PF = x + 2 waxay kuu ogolaanaysaa inaad go'aamiso baaxadda qiimayaasha suurtagalka ah. Tani ma aha kiis macluumaad yar.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.o.d: Midna. PF had iyo jeer waa ugu yaraan 2
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.d: x + 2 wuxuu noqonayaa 2 marka x uu yahay qiimaha ugu yar ee uu qaadan karo. Tani waa xukun baaray baaxadda suurtagalka ah ee masaafada.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.explain: PF = x + 2, parabola-na x ≥ 0, sidaas darteed PF ≥ 2. Si PF = 1 loo helo waxaa loo baahan lahaa x = −1, laakiin markaas y² = −8 oo y dhab ah ma jiro. Shuruud masaafo waxay yeelan kartaa xal midna ah.
